verdict.rationale: GitLab's Duo Agent Platform is agentic, so plugging external MCP servers into it is a fair question, but the pack never documents MCP client support. The MCP evidence is server-side only: the official GitLab MCP server and the Orbit MCP tools let external agents call GitLab, not the reverse. Choosing tools for custom agents is an adjacent feature with no mention of connecting external MCP servers, so it earns no credit.
